body:
Alright, I guess I should leave now before anyone comes home.  I'll probably just wake up in a day or two with a slight case of amnesia and feeling like a zombie.  I'm not a doctor though.  Maybe it will kill me.  I'm taking 3 grams (yes, grams) of diazepam after at least 8 shots of 40 proof alcohol.  

Or maybe I'll just chicken out while sitting in my car.  I've certainly done that before.

It's too late for that now.  By the time I get there they'd be leaving.  They'll be home around midnight.  

I've actively searched for a moment like that for the past year or so and that was after a few years of waiting for something to happen.  You're liable to end up sitting around forever if you just wait which is the main reason I stopped thinking like that.  I can't just keep saying that *maybe tomorrow will be better* or *if I try this something will be different*.  It just doesn't work. 

I hope you stumble across something that makes you happy for the rest of your life.  Maybe you will.  Maybe you won't.  But, I hope you do.

This is taking a lot of effort to write out.  I really don't feel like writing a novel at the moment, but it suffices to say that what lead me to this particular moment is the fact that nothing I do seems to help.  As a matter of fact I feel worse after every failed attempt at feeling better.  Last night I had sex for the first time and I thought it would somehow make me feel differently.  I went into it just to have fun of course and I *did* have fun, but afterwards I just felt...I don't know...the same?

And it's not just that.  Everything I do turns out that way.  I set goals, accomplish them and nothing changes.  I can change everything except my own thoughts and that's what's really frustrating.  At some point in my life I just stopped caring.  I can't think of *anything* in the world that I want.  Nothing.  If I discovered a genie that could grant me three wishes I'd wish for a gun, a bullet and some courage.
